question: Does paired intervention and duration regret learning improve actual navigation beyond ordinary recovery value learning?
common_fixes: nearest five before truncation, at current and successor positions
relative human coordinates not translated twice
smooth candidate velocities before safety/value evaluation and execute exactly those velocities

options.projection: nearest of original 80 commands, followed by shared smoothing and safety
options.eligibility: all episodes after four observed steps; no outcome or stall filtering
options.unsafe_recovery: terminate option and execute nominal action if selected recovery fails same clearance mask

data.root_selection: all existing preregistered roots, including successful nominal episodes
data.labels: all 10 options to native termination, same root state/history and same remaining deadline, then frozen nominal continuation

recovery_training.network: frozen nominal GRU feature plus legal progress/geometry/time descriptors -> 128 ReLU -> 10 values
recovery_training.simple_loss: MSE absolute Monte Carlo returns for all 10 choices
recovery_training.new_loss: nominal value MSE + MSE of paired recovery-minus-nominal return + within-direction duration-difference MSE

go: new exceeds both nominal and ordinary Q by >=3pp success, improves native mean discounted return, no additional collision or geometry-contact episodes, and successes improve in >=2 of the 3 dense/large-square scenes; freeze and fresh confirm
fresh_confirmation: same point-estimate and safety rule, plus paired case-block bootstrap 95% lower bound for success improvement above zero against both controls; resample each case ID jointly across all six scenes and all arms; no development retuning
kill: correctly activated method fails the development rule; no tuning to rescue it
repair: at most one, only if a demonstrated implementation or representational defect prevents the specified mechanism
claim_limits: single frozen nominal training seed, paired case inference only
ordinary absolute-Q receives identical paired outcomes
paired advantages and learned durations are not claimed novel
no reciprocal pedestrian yielding: robot waits for externally moving pedestrians
development run is not a paper-grade full reproduction
